read.thesis: Ally's Q3 CY26 earnings rose on auto originations up 10% to $12.9B and NIM ex-OID of 3.66%, but provisions jumped 27% to $529M on asset growth, and no capacity or supply discipline was discussed.

triggers.label: Auto originations up 10% YoY
triggers.quote: $12.9 billion of consumer auto originations, up 10% year over year | Record 4.8 million consumer auto applications, up 20% year over year

triggers.label: Retail auto NCO 189 bps, +1 bp YoY
triggers.quote: Retail auto net charge-offs of 189 bps were up 1 bps year over year
triggers.highlight: Retail auto net charge-offs of 189 bps

red_flags.label: Provision up 27% YoY on asset growth
red_flags.quote: Provision for credit losses increased $114 million year over year to $529 million, primarily due to CECL reserve builds associated with asset growth during the quarter.

red_flags.label: Adjusted TBVPS down 3% QoQ
red_flags.quote: Adjusted Tangible Book Value per Share $41.00 $42.12 $39.19 (3)% 5%
